scope: Twenty-third bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved HR targets; three independently accepted direct recommendations and five conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: The eight target IDs in ordinal order joined by LF with no terminal LF.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Repository, family and adjacent-record behavior do not inherit credit.
methodology.reuse_rule: Wave-7 and Wave-9 overlap at repository or bounded source-slice level is disclosed. Each direct outcome is restricted to its target-specific fields and no earlier or adjacent target inherits credit.

HRMS.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

ORANGEHRM.edition_boundary: Pinned public Starter source only; proprietary editions, hosted behavior, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

ERPNEXT.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Manage candidate communications through governed recipients, templates, rendering and delivery provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: orangehrm/orangehrm candidate history and API at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Generic candidate history and note records do not provide recipient selection, template CRUD/rendering or delivery state and provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Manage candidate referees, reference evidence, review and provenance through an owned lifecycle.
evaluations.research_candidate: orangehrm/orangehrm candidate record at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: Candidate fields and attachments do not establish referee records, reference review, update lifecycle or provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Define reusable named competencies and link expected skills to roles or designations.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/hrms skill, designation-skill and expected-skill-set records at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The pinned records define a named competency catalogue and reusable expected-skill links for designations. The claim does not inherit assessment, authorization, Site or Oblivion runtime behavior.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Persist employee competency ratings and evaluation evidence against defined skills.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/hrms employee skill-map, employee-skill and skill-assessment records at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The pinned records persist an employee skill map with ratings and evaluation evidence. The bounded assessment claim does not inherit competency-definition, expiry, Site, approval or runtime behavior.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern job approval decisions with authorized transition owner, time, reason, replay and history.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/hrms job requisition record at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Pending, Open & Approved and Rejected enum values do not establish an authorized decision transition with owner, time, reason, replay and history.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Retrieve and update an access-scoped operational employee personal and employment profile.
evaluations.research_candidate: orangehrm/orangehrm personal-detail API and employee entity at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The accessible-employee personal-detail API retrieves and updates personal profile fields, while the cited entity spans expose bounded employment status, job-title and organizational-unit context. This does not infer company or manager relationships and does not inherit account or position lifecycle, Site privacy, timeline aggregation or Oblivion runtime behavior.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Provide an authorized actor- and time-attributed staff timeline aggregating governed events.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/erpnext employee work-history fields at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Work-history fields and validation are not an authorized actor- and time-attributed timeline aggregation surface.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern vetting checks through consent, evidence, verification, expiry/review and reviewer provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: orangehrm/orangehrm employee licence entity at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: An employee licence record does not establish a vetting-check lifecycle, consent, evidence, verification, review or reviewer provenance.

collision_disclosure.target_keys: All eight targets were completion-unproved with zero credit before Wave 23; exact target-key collision with materialized Waves 4-22 is zero.
collision_disclosure.hrms: Wave 7 cited skill and employee-skill records for different catalog and assessment-matrix targets. Wave 23 uses bounded target-specific slices only; no source-family inheritance is allowed.
collision_disclosure.erpnext: Wave 9 cited ERPNext Employee blobs for employee-account and position targets. Wave 23 staff-profile credit is limited to separately pinned operational profile fields and does not inherit those credits.
collision_disclosure.orangehrm: No materialized OrangeHRM source collision was found; public Starter source is the only edition in scope.
collision_disclosure.wave22: Wave 22 CiviCRM, ERPNext finance and OpenEMR loci are target-disjoint; no no-match decision is recommended in Wave 23.
